Chinatown Story Cart

collection

This is an art project created 2020-2021. In collaboration with local youth groups like BCNC, CSTO, and ACDC, interviews were collected and visual media was created about the Chinatown community's lives and their experience of the pandemic. It also includes story sets with visual art and reflection activities sent to and collected from the residents. The majority of the collection is digitized.
